2014_spells.hypnotic-pattern.description: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this spell, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0. The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.
2014_spells.hypnotic-pattern.effectSumma: Make a target charmed until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.hypnotic-pattern.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, you create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; While charmed by this spell, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0. The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
